note: NQ1: the auto-researcher's Nasdaq 100 leads (stretch, breakout and big-candle combinations) and the Nasdaq breakout of the day, each a reading of its own. Before costs; readings overlap, so totals are not additive. The leads came out of a search of over 100 million tries. Nothing is traded and results are before costs; a paper record of the rule, not a trade signal.
